Where AI Helps and Where It Hurts

While 81% of consumers find AI tools useful, 80% have been frustrated by at least one, and 93% say these tools can sometimes worsen their experience. Top complaints include interruptions, impersonal responses, and difficulty reaching a human.

"Consumers appreciate AI when it saves time or simplifies the experience," said Godreau. "But when it disrupts the journey, frustration sets in."

Chatbots are a common source of frustration. Nearly half of users say they often fall short, and 87% still need human support to fully resolve issues.

Transparency Builds Trust

results.title: Document Data Automation Tools : Molku AI
results.content:
Manually copying information between documents, spreadsheets, and forms can be repetitive, time-consuming, and prone to errors. Molku AI automates this process by extracting selected data from a wide range of document formats and transferring it directly into PDFs or Google Sheets. [...] The platform supports scans, Word documents, Excel files, CSVs, handwritten records, and other common formats, helping users streamline data entry workflows. After a simple setup, the same automation can be reused repeatedly, reducing manual work and improving consistency. Whether processing business records, managing forms, or organising information across multiple systems, users can move data more efficiently without constant copying and pasting. Molku AI helps individuals and teams save time by turning document handling into an automated workflow. The platform offers a practical solution for anyone looking to simplify document processing and improve productivity through intelligent data extraction.
